coverage_notes: Supplementary high-value recall only, not the authoritative nationwide production collector. Checked sole/last/full-service grocery closure or fire/disaster; canceled emergency food distributions attributable to storm, flood, fire, outage or facility damage; abrupt pantry/food-bank access cuts; and new official SNAP/WIC/EBT access interruptions.

Twelve targeted web searches completed (eight fast and four slow, with two-day recency filters). Search results were predominantly older, non-U.S., non-qualifying or duplicate; no new qualifying, independently supported disruption was verified in the 09:47:44–10:43 PDT window. Search indexing is incomplete, and this is not a claim of nationwide absence.
